chunks: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Fadhl said: Sindi ibn al-Rabi' narrated to us from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Ibn Muskhan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"Whoever is manumitted against an inheritance before it is divided, he has his inheritance; and if he is manumitted after it is divided, he has no inheritance."
ai.seo_question: Does a freed slave inherit from his master if manumission happens after the estate is divided?
ai.summary: This ruling from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the precise moment of manumission relative to estate division, ensuring that a slave becomes a full heir only if freed before the distribution of assets. This distinction prevents the master from manipulating timing to exclude the slave, reflecting the Shia juristic emphasis on the immediate vesting of rights upon the master's death.
